text: Risk management is the process of identifying, assessing, and controlling potential problems that could affect a project or business. The first step is identifying risks, which means finding out what could go wrong and how likely it is to happen. Once risks are clear, you can develop mitigation strategies to reduce their impact or prevent them from occurring. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, which are backup plans you can use if a problem actually happens. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks can change over time. By checking regularly, you can respond quickly and keep the situation under control. Good risk management helps individuals and organizations avoid surprises and protect their goals.
